daemon.conf_path.description: The path to the main system-wide configuration file.

generic_options.description: Comma-separated list of options applying to all daemons defined in this file or included directories.

services.description: A list of named daemon configurations to include in the file. Each item defines a specific daemon instance's options.

services.items.description: A comma-separated string representing the configuration directive for a specific named daemon. Format: 'name=<name>,<option>=<value>,...'.
